subject: HS/Npt with 9 founders: modifier gene project with AT mutation introduced from 129SVE background

messages.author: 9053d0a58f5263a2
messages.subject: HS/Npt with 9 founders: modifier gene project with AT mutation introduced from 129SVE background
parts:
I have a modifier gene project involving F1 mice from (129 AT-KO x HS/Npt). The phenotype for Ataxia Telangiectasia (AT) mutated is thymic lymphoma (CoxPH time to event) and cerebellar Purkinje cell loss. 


The major problem I have is how to reconstruct haplotypes with the 9 founders 

  1. 129SVE (KO allele background),
  2. HS/Npt: AKR, AJ, BALB, C3H, C57, CBA, DBA, LP/J

We genotyped (GigaMUGA) ~1,200 mice, which includes individuals from all 9 founder strains.


Is it possible to create eight F1 "founder strains" (i.e., 129xAKR, 129xAJ, 129xBALB, 129xC3H, etc) from the SNP data I have from the 9 founder strains? 


I see that there is a "dof1" cross function - can this be modified for HS/Npt data?  



Here is an example of cancer modifier gene project using DO F1s (TRAMP x J:DO); however, the TRAMP is on one of the 8 backgrounds of the J:D0...

https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2405471216303611


Any help is appreciated!

Elijah

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] HS/Npt with 9 founders: modifier gene project with AT mutation introduced from 129SVE background
parts:
I'd recommend using the "dof1" cross type. I guess I should create an "hsf1", but the "dof1" is probably close enough.

With the "dof1" cross type, the parental genotype data should include the 9 parents: the 8 founders for the DO (or HS in your case) and then the 9th being the 129 AT-KO line.
The cross info should be a single column with number of generations for the HS parent.

karl
